title: The Feather Trail
intro: This quiz follows Nia, Kai, and Meera as they learn what makes birds special and how feathers, wings, beaks, and hollow bones help them survive.

questions.prompt: Which feature is found on every bird?
questions.explanation: Feathers are found on every bird.

choices: They help with flight, warmth, and protection
questions.explanation: Feathers help birds with flight, warmth, and protection.

questions.prompt: Why are many bird bones hollow?
choices: To make the body lighter for flight
questions.explanation: Many bird bones are hollow to make the body lighter for flight.

questions.prompt: Why do different birds have different kinds of beaks?
choices: Their beaks are shaped for the kinds of food they eat
All birds use their beaks in exactly the same way
questions.explanation: Different birds have different kinds of beaks because their beaks are shaped for the kinds of food they eat.

questions.prompt: Which statement about birds is correct?
choices: Birds are mammals because they are warm-blooded
Birds have feathers, lay eggs, and are warm-blooded vertebrates
questions.explanation: Birds have feathers, lay eggs, and are warm-blooded vertebrates.
